rationale.rewrite_question: Use gpt-4.1-mini-cloud for rewriting rather than qwen-local to test whether higher-quality question normalization improves downstream retrieval/answer quality without paying gpt-5.5 rates.

proposals.description: Explore a higher-quality cloud configuration by assigning both answer generation and initial query/response generation to gpt-5.5 while keeping lightweight rewrite and post-retrieval decision steps local to control cost and latency.

rationale.decide_after_retrieval: Kept on qwen-local because it is a lightweight non-structured, non-tool branch/decision-style step and local inference avoids cloud cost.
rationale.generate_answer: Moved to gpt-5.5-cloud to test quality gains on the final answer synthesis stage, likely the most user-visible quality-critical unit despite higher cost.
rationale.generate_query_or_respond: Moved to gpt-5.5-cloud to explore whether stronger reasoning/query formulation improves retrieval path quality or direct response quality upstream.
rationale.rewrite_question: Kept on qwen-local because rewriting is typically short and bounded, with no special capability requirements; local placement minimizes cost.
